get.summary: Compare attempt and payment states with Nodo Online
get.description: Read-only. Resolves token, PA/NAV and datasource from the retained attempt, using the existing serviceIdentifier routing. No query parameters or projection writes. Missing Online snapshots are independent null values; duplicate or unsupported snapshots fail explicitly. projectionRevision identifies the captured observation, not a distributed transaction across both databases.

200.description: Real Nodo Online comparison, including absent snapshots

404.description: Attempt absent, outside caller visibility or expired

500.description: Incomplete projection, duplicate or invalid snapshot, or server error

503.description: DB_UNAVAILABLE: database failure or timeout, no partial result

post.summary: Consult a bounded RE diagnostic window
post.description: Read-only; disabled until deployment verification and personal-data approval. Explicit UTC [from,to), maximum 24h. Resolves PA/NAV/token and expiry server-side. All RE events matching the AND keys are included, without FSM/primitive filters. With scope POSITION the paymentToken key is dropped: events of the whole PA + NAV pair, including token-less calls such as verifyPaymentNotice, are returned. Coverage never means full history; retained windows may be clipped. Signed opaque seek cursors freeze the ingestion watermark and expire after at most 300s. Maximum 100 events/page, 1000 events/consultation, 5MiB JSON/response. Decoded payload is untrusted plain text; no interpretation or decompression. All responses, including errors, are no-store.

200.description: Window-only diagnostic result; never full history

400.description: Invalid explicit UTC window, body, query or cursor

410.description: Attempt expired (if its projection row is still present)

429.description: Rate, concurrency or consultation admission limit

200.description: SSE frames: event type in event:, JSON envelope in data:. Heartbeats are comments.

get.summary: Cache version of NDP001 and NDP004
get.description: Read-only. Calls Nodo monitoring once per node (X-Ndp-Target) in parallel and aggregates the results. A node that is unconfigured or unreachable is reported with its outcome and null cache fields, without failing the whole response.

200.description: One entry per node, including failed ones

title.description: A short, summary of the problem type. Written in english and readable for engineers (usually not suited for non technical stakeholders and not localized); example: Service Unavailable

status.description: The HTTP status code generated by the origin server for this occurrence of the problem.

details.description: A human readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.
details.example: There was an error processing the request

from.description: Inclusive UTC instant ending in Z

to.description: Exclusive UTC instant; from < to <= from + 24h

cursor.description: Opaque signed seek cursor; repeat the original window

scope.description: ATTEMPT (default): PA + NAV + token of the attempt. POSITION: PA + NAV only, so events without a paymentToken (verifyPaymentNotice) are included, together with those of every token.

RecipientDto.description: Receipt recipient keyed by PA/NAV/stazioneRecipient. No token association or primary role.

stazioneRecipient.description: Null denotes the single unidentified recipient of this logical pair.

outcome.description: SYNCED when the projection changed, otherwise NOOP

state.description: State returned by Nodo Online, or null when the source snapshot is missing
